groundTruthBias: Known issues are manually curated from later standalone fixes and each issue represents one conceptual defect with explicit semantic aliases and all eligible reviewed-revision locations. This covers only defects noticed and fixed later. Clean controls mean no later fix was linked to that pull request through the observation cutoff, not proof that the change has no latent defect. Compare paired arms on this frozen corpus; do not treat absolute recall as a repository bug-finding rate.

cases.title: fix(desktop): dereference @kinqs workspace symlinks before electron-builder (#743)

issues.description: The dereference sweep exits when any workspace symlink has no dist directory, including workspaces outside the desktop package dependency closure, so an unrelated unbuilt workspace aborts packaging.
The dereference helper copies only package.json and dist instead of the package's declared files, so runtime assets such as config or agents disappear from the packaged application.

cases.title: fix(desktop): verify packaged browser without debugger (#1242)

issues.description: The packaged smoke verifies only the browser bridge and never invokes the utility host or workspace-manifest path, so a package missing required runtime assets can still pass.
The packaged smoke isolates Chromium's profile but does not override HOME, USERPROFILE, or BrainRouter state, so it can read a developer's real configuration and produce a non-hermetic result.
The release smoke enables a DevTools remote-debugging listener inside the packaged application, adding a debugger attack surface to production qualification instead of using an in-process self-test.

cases.title: feat(0.4.1): brain-side job queue + agent registry (BRAIN-P1) (#70)

issues.description: Agent-job idempotency lists in-flight rows and then inserts separately, allowing concurrent deliveries to both observe no row and enqueue duplicate work.

cases.title: feat(desktop): in-app Monaco code editor (editable tabs, save, dirty, preview fallback) (#446)

issues.description: CSS palette values are passed directly into Monaco's theme, but Monaco requires hex colors; hsl/rgb values can throw and leave the editor on its fallback theme.

cases.title: feat(desktop): per-session model — each chat keeps its own model (item 10) (#416)

issues.description: The model selector defaults to global scope, so an ordinary model pick changes the shared default and synchronizes into other chats despite the per-session feature contract.
